context: Grandmother and granddaughter sort through old household items
purpose: Teach: 壊れ/絵画/電池/セール/雑貨/照明/バッグ/真似

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: この押し入れ、長年そのままだったから、一旦全部出してみましょうね。
lines.en: This closet has been untouched for years, so let's take everything out for now.
lines.style: Gentle elderly voice, slightly slow, warm and inviting tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わあ、おばあちゃん、この絵画きれい！壁にかかってた風景画だよね？
lines.en: Wow, Grandma, this painting is beautiful! It's the landscape that used to hang on the wall, right?
lines.style: Bright teenage girl, curious and excited, rising intonation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ええ、でもこの古い照明、もう壊れて点かないのよ。電池式の小さいランプもどこかにあったわね。
lines.en: Yes, but this old lamp is broken and won't turn on anymore. There was a small battery-powered lamp somewhere too.
lines.style: Reflective grandmother tone, soft sighs between thoughts.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あ、この革のバッグかわいい！昔のセールで買ったやつ？
lines.en: Oh, this leather bag is cute! Did you buy it on sale long ago?
lines.style: Playful teen, leaning forward with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そうそう、駅前の雑貨屋さんでね。お母さんがいつも私の趣味を真似して、同じようなのを買っていたわ。
lines.en: That's right, at the variety store in front of the station. Your mother always copied my taste and bought similar things.
lines.style: Warm nostalgic chuckle, fond memories in her voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ふふ、ママらしいね。ねえ、これ捨てないで、私が部屋で使ってもいい？
lines.en: Haha, that's so like Mom. Hey, don't throw it away — can I use it in my room?
lines.style: Affectionate teen, hopeful and slightly pleading.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: もちろん。物を大切にしてくれると、おばあちゃんも嬉しいわ。
lines.en: Of course. It makes Grandma happy when you treasure things.
lines.style: Tender, heartfelt grandmother voice, soft and content.
